exo01/__init__.py.name: The toolkit's front door
exo01/__init__.py.description: Names the toolkit and its version; holds no calculation of its own.

exo01/config.py.name: Reading a set-up
exo01/config.py.description: Loads the description of the platform, applies the variations you asked for, and checks that nothing essential is missing.

exo01/reference.py.name: Reading the reference drawings
exo01/reference.py.description: Opens the measured drawing package of the platform and checks it: units, overall size, float positions and the weights that came with it.

exo01/scenarios.py.name: Saving and comparing set-ups
exo01/scenarios.py.description: Saves a set-up under a name and builds the side-by-side table; anything that was not computed stays blank rather than being filled in.

exo01/units.py.name: Units and constants
exo01/units.py.description: One place for metres, degrees, gravity and the density of fresh water, so no conversion is done twice.
